question: Does the Lord remain free both within established order and beyond it?
premises: A long-established rule may be cut off or set in motion.
Even where no rule has yet taken root, activity may arise.
In both cases the Lord remains independent.
inference: The consciousness-sky Bhairava is sovereign over both the maintenance and suspension of order.
plain_english: Whether by cutting off or setting in motion a long-established rule, or even where no rule has yet taken root, this Bhairava of the sky of consciousness remains independent.
